Name: Find Item
Author: ogahalo00
Description:
[b]🌟 Find Item - A Smart Inventory Search Tool for Stardew Valley[/b]
[b]Find Item[/b] is a quality-of-life mod designed to help you effortlessly locate any item you own in [i]Stardew Valley[/i]. Ever lost track of where you put that rare material or tool? This mod is made for you.
With [b]Find Item[/b], you can instantly search across your [b]inventory[/b], [b]chests[/b], [b]fridge[/b], and other [b]storage containers[/b] to pinpoint the exact location of your items.
Inspired by popular mods like [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url][/b], [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27409]Item Locator[/url][/b], and[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2086] [b]Where’s My Items[/b][/url], this mod provides a familiar yet streamlined and user-friendly experience for managing your farm's inventory.

✨ Features[list]
[*]🔍 [b]Search instantly[/b] across your inventory, chests, fridge, and all storage containers.
[/list][list]
[*][b]NEW[/b]
[*]Chests in [b]other players' cabins[/b]
[*]Chests in [b]farm buildings[/b] like Barns, Coops, and Sheds
[/list][list]
[*]🧭 [b]Visual path highlights[/b] guide you directly to the item’s location.
[*]🎮 [b]Customizable hotkeys[/b] for:
[list]
[*]Opening the search menu (SearchKey)
[*]Quick search for the last used item (QuickSearchKey)
[*]﻿Hiding visual paths (HidePathKey)
[*]Toggling the mod on or off (ToggleKey)
[/list][*]⏱️ [b]Auto-hide item paths[/b] after a delay (optional and configurable).
[*]⚙️ [b]Lightweight and easy to use[/b] — configure it once, and it works seamlessly in the background.
[*]✅ [b]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+ and SMAPI 4.0+[/b]
[/list][line]🛠 Default ConfigurationEdit the [code]config.json[/code] file inside the [code]Mods/Find-Item
[/code] folder to change any setting to match your playstyle.
json
CopyEdit
[code]{
"ToggleKey": "None",
"SearchKey": "F2",
"QuickSearchKey": "D",
"HidePathKey": "H",
"ModEnabled": true,
"AutoHidePaths": true,
"AutoHideDelay": 60}
[/code]
[line]🚀 How to Use[list=1]
[*][b]Install[/b] the mod according to the instructions in the readme.

[*]Launch [i]Stardew Valley[/i] once to generate the [code]config.json[/code] file.

[*]Open [code]Mods/Find-Item/config.json[/code] and customize your hotkeys and preferences.

[*]In game, press your configured keys to:
[list]
[*]Open the item search menu.
[*]Quickly locate items.
[*]Toggle visual guidance paths.
[*]Manage your inventory more efficiently than ever!
[/list]
[/list][line]📫 Support & FeedbackIf you run into issues or have suggestions:
[list]
[*]Join the Stardew Valley Discord and ask for help in the [code]#modded-tech-support[/code] channel.
[*]Upload your SMAPI log at [url=https://smapi.io/log]https://smapi.io/log[/url] and include the link in your report.
[*]Or open an issue on the [url=https://github.com/QuangBM138/Find-Item/issues]Issues · QuangBM138/Find-Item[/url].
[/list]Even if the game doesn't visibly crash, your SMAPI log helps diagnose problems quickly.
